entries.title: Show HN: Dropflow, a CSS layout engine for node or <canvas>
entries.author: chearon
entries.current_title: Show HN: Dropflow, a CSS layout engine for node or <canvas>
entries.excerpt: For the last 5 years I've been working on a layout engine that targets CSS2 and some more modern properties. Live demo: https://chearon.github.io/dropflow/ It matches browsers in all cases I can find where they agree, and it's fast. It supports `position`, `inline-block`, `z-index`, and complex properties like `float` and `vertical-align`. entries.guide_zh: Dropflow 为 Node 或 Canvas 提供 CSS 布局引擎，作者分享五年的实现成果。

entries.title: Show HN: I made a cheap alternative to college-level math & physics tutoring
entries.author: eltonlin
entries.current_title: Show HN: I made a cheap alternative to college-level math & physics tutoring
entries.excerpt: Hi everyone! I’m the founder of Explanations (https://explanations.app). I’m building a website where students can get college level math & physics help for 1/10th the cost of private tutoring. You’d type a question, and your teacher replies by drawing a Youtube/KhanAcademy-style video; and this happens asynchronously throughout the week. When I was studying at MIT, I often had to wait 40-60 minutes in line just to get 5 minutes of “help” from a TA - when I needed 1-2 hours.
entries.guide_zh: Explanations 让老师用绘图解答大学数学和物理题，作者希望降低辅导费用。
